artworks.title: The Yellow-breasted Chat
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: A bird with gray wings and a bright yellow belly is perched upon a plant with wide, dark green leaves and vibrant purple flowers. The color palette of the image includes shades of gray, yellow, dark green, and purple against a light, neutral background. The bird is situated above the leaves, with its wings slightly open, while the plant extends downward, showing its roots at the bottom. Detailed textures of the bird's feathers and the plant's leaves and roots are prominent in the composition.

artworks.title: The Soree (Rallus Virginianus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird and a flowering plant. The image features a bird standing on a small piece of rocky ground with long legs and a slightly curved beak. Adjacent to the bird is a tall, slender plant with large green leaves and blue flowers. The background is a simple light color, emphasizing the natural elements in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Oyster-catcher (Hoematopus ostralegus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird standing on a rock with a branch nearby. The bird has a long, slender, red beak and red eyes. It has a brown body with a white patch on its wings and light-colored legs. The rock is textured, and there is a green branch with elongated leaves and two rounded fruits or buds. A simple background is visible with a horizontal line at the bottom. The style suggests a focus on ornithological or botanical illustration.

artworks.title: The Green Lizard of Jamaica (Lacerta bullaris)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a green lizard with a red throat perched on a plant with pink and yellow flowers. The plant has green leaves, pink and yellow flowers, and brown seed pods. The lizard is positioned on a branch with leaves and flowers around it, along with hanging seed pods.

artworks.title: The Lyon Lizard (Lacerta 6-lineata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image includes a green-stemmed plant with elongated leaves and two prominent flowers, one yellow and the other white. A lizard is on the plant's stem. The color palette consists of green, yellow, gray, and white against a light background. The plant stretches from the bottom to the top of the image, with the lizard positioned in the middle, wrapping its tail around the stem above visible roots at the base.

artworks.title: The Lyon Lizard (Lacerta 6-lineata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image depicts a plant with elongated green leaves and a flower with long yellow petals and white internal petals. There is a lizard clinging to the plant's stem. The plant's leaves, lizard, and flower are rendered in shades of green, brown, yellow, and white. The plant extends vertically, with the lizard positioned lower on the stem and the flower at the top.

artworks.title: The Land Frog (Rana)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image features a large pitcher plant on the left and another similar plant structure with a rounded, green and red-veined hood on the right, both leaning towards the center. Below them is a yellow and green flower with yellow petals and brown details. At the bottom, there is a small brown frog with a black outline around its red eye in the center. The color palette includes shades of green, brown, yellow, and hints of red.

artworks.title: The Bahama Coney (Mus Monax)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is an image of a small rodent surrounded by foliage and berries. The painting features a detailed depiction of a brown-furred rodent with a realistic texture and shading to show its fur and musculature. The rodent is shown on four legs with a slightly curved posture. Its tail extends out behind it, and its ears are perked attentively. Around the animal are branches of foliage with green leaves. Some branches have red berries, while others have blue flowers and buds. The background is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Golden Pheasant (Chrysolophus pictus)
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green

artworks.title: Green Heron, Night Heron, Young Heron, and Great White Heron
artworks.artist: John G. Warnicke after Alexander Wilson
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This painting depicts four different species of herons together. The birds are detailed in appearance, showcasing their distinct features and plumage colors. One heron has white plumage and an orange beak, standing on the left. Another heron with turquoise body and chestnut chest is perched on a branch to the right. A dark-capped heron with gray and black wing pattern is shown below, facing the viewer. There is a heron with brown speckles and a red eye under the tall heron. The background features grass, water, and distant landforms, emphasizing the birds. The style is similar to John James Audubon's accurate bird depictions.

artworks.title: Louisiana Heron, Pied Oyster-catcher, Hooping Crane, and Long-billed Curlew
artworks.artist: John G. Warnicke after Alexander Wilson
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving with etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a collection of birds standing near a body of water. The painting depicts four different bird species positioned on the ground near the water's edge. The largest bird, a crane, stands prominently with elongated legs and neck, its feathers detailed in white and grayish shades. Accompanying the crane is a heron with a slender body and pointed beak, showcased by its distinctive blue and white plumage. A black and white oystercatcher is also present, distinguishable by its bright red legs and beak. The fourth bird, a long-billed curlew, is portrayed with brown and tan patterning on its feathers and a notably long, curved bill. The background displays a serene lake with gentle ripples, set against a landscape of distant hills and soft, cloud-filled skies. This is in style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: The Swallow Tail Hawk (Falco furcatus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch. The bird has a slender form with a long tail, primarily blue plumage with hints of green on the wings and tail feathers. The bird's head is turned to the side, displaying a sharp, slightly curved beak and a vibrant red eye. It is perched on a narrow, brown branch, against a plain light-colored background. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: The Red Winged Starling (Oriolus phoeniceus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a red-winged starling perched on a branch with green leaves and berries. The starling is depicted with its wings slightly open, showcasing its red and yellow shoulder markings against a mostly black plumage. The bird's head is turned downwards, focusing on its footing on the green branch. Beside the bird, there is a branch with elongated, glossy green leaves and clusters of small dark berries. The composition combines detailed illustration with an emphasis on the bird's vivid coloration and the plant’s texture.

artworks.title: The Fieldfare of Carolina (Turdus migratorius)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a bird with a red breast and brown wing laying upside-down on a tree stump. There are vibrant green leaves and vine-like plants surrounding the bird. The color palette consists mainly of bright red and rich browns for the bird, complemented by the deep green of the foliage and a neutral tan background. The bird's head is toward the left side of the image with its body and tail extending to the right, while the leaves of the plant are positioned above and around the bird's body.

artworks.title: The Flamingo (Phoenicopterus ruber)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This image depicts a red bird standing in front of a leafless tree, with a coastal background. The bird has a vivid red body and long legs, positioned centrally. The tree has slender, twisted branches reaching upwards. The background features a calm sea, rocky outcrops, and small palm-like trees. In the foreground, there is grass and a starfish. The colors are earthy, emphasizing textures. The composition resembles classical natural history illustrations, focusing on detailed depiction.

artworks.title: The Hooping Crane (Ardea Americana)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows the head and neck of a large bird with a long, straight brown bill and brown plumage on the head, set against a light beige background. Next to the bird is a branch with dark purple berries and green leaves.

artworks.title: The Blue Winged Shoveler (Anas clypeata foemina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird with a large, wide bill positioned on grassy terrain. The bird has detailed feather patterns, brown plumage, wings with blue and green sections, orange-red legs and webbed feet, and a yellow iris with a black pupil. The illustration showcases the bird in a natural history style, emphasizing the bird's textures and colors. The background is a plain, light color, keeping the focus on the bird.

artworks.title: The Globe Fish (Tetrodon lagocephalus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image displays large green leaves, a fish with a spherical body and a textured pattern, small blue berries, pink flowers, and various shades of green and earthy tones.

artworks.title: The Vanelloe (Epidendrum Vanilla)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with broad pointed leaves and two flowers - one white and the other golden-brown. The color palette includes shades of green for the leaves, brown for the stems, and light colors for the flowers against a cream background. The white flower is in the center with curled petals, and the golden-brown flower is to the left. The elongated leaves fan out in different directions.

artworks.title: The Laughing Gull (Larus articilla)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a bird perched on a textured rock by the sea. The bird has a dark head, grey body, slender legs with webbed feet, an open beak with a vibrant orange interior, and long, overlapping tail feathers. There is water visible at the bottom left of the rock.

artworks.title: Red Frangipanni (Plumeria rubra)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plumeria plant. The illustration features green elongated leaves and pink flowers at the center surrounded by various shades of green, pink, yellow, and white. The composition includes the flowers at the top center, surrounded by large leaves extending outward symmetrically, with the plant stem visible below in front of a light background.

artworks.title: Cat's Claw (Mimosa circinalis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image displays a small leafy tree or branch with pink fluffy flowers in the upper right. In the lower right, there is a large, intricately patterned butterfly. The color palette includes shades of green, light brown, pink, vibrant yellow, and black. Brown seed pods are observed hanging down in the center left of the image. The tree occupies the top half of the image, with the butterfly in the bottom right showcasing its wings' patterns and colors.

artworks.title: Cross-vine (Bignonia capreolata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed botanical illustration of a flowering plant with bright orange and yellow trumpet-shaped flowers and elongated green leaves. The color palette consists of earthy tones with vibrant yellows and oranges contrasted by deep green foliage. The plant is located in the central and right part of the composition, with its slender stem ascending vertically. To the left of the plant, there is an elongated brown pod with seeds visible within it.

artworks.title: The Lane-snapper (Sparus synagris)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two fish. The larger fish has a striped body with reddish-brown and gold colors, a red tail fin and eye. The smaller fish is dark grey with a lighter underbelly and small fins, positioned below the larger fish. The color palette includes warm tones such as reddish-brown, golden yellow, and gray.
